{{Quote|This whole star system is a crisis point. Republic and Empire are testing one another's strength. Meanwhile, the terrorists lurk in the middle.|[[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Balmorra system''', also known as the '''Nevoota system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The system contained six planets.<ref name="TORpl" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While first known as the Nevoota system, the Balmorra system was first mentioned in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]." ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' also called it the latter name, in its convention of naming every system after its primary planet.
